name: temporary-worktree-cleanup
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,shutil
base=Path('/var/folders/0v/f_smd31500113ppkqs66c9yr0000gn/T/spec-first-cycle1-20260920-qh_ul_2o')
repo=base/'repo'; delivered=Path('/Users/kuang/xiaobu/spec-first/docs/validation/project-lead-cycle-1/u9')
before=subprocess.check_output(['git','worktree','list','--porcelain'],text=True)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],cwd=repo,text=True)
copy=json.loads((delivered/'copy-integrity.json').read_text())
source=repo/'.spec-first/audits/full-system/2026-09-20-cycle1-u9'
for row in copy['files']:
 assert hashlib.sha256((delivered/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256((source/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
for a,b in [('b-review-results.json','reviewer-returns/b.json'),('c1-review-results.json','reviewer-returns/c1.json')]:
 assert (base/a).read_bytes()==(delivered/b).read_bytes()
result=subprocess.run(['git','worktree','remove',str(repo)],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(json.dumps({'remove_exit':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr},ensure_ascii=False))
if result.returncode: raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
assert set(x.name for x in base.iterdir())=={'b-review-results.json','c1-review-results.json'}
for x in base.iterdir(): x.unlink()
base.rmdir()
after=subprocess.check_output(['git','worktree','list','--porcelain'],text=True)
before_paths=[s[9:] for s in before.splitlines() if s.startswith('worktree ')]
after_paths=[s[9:] for s in after.splitlines() if s.startswith('worktree ')]
assert set(before_paths)-set(after_paths)=={str(repo.resolve())}
assert set(after_paths)<=set(before_paths)
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','temporary_root_removed':not base.exists(),'copied_evidence_verified':len(copy['files']),'worktrees_before':len(before_paths),'worktrees_after':len(after_paths),'other_worktrees_preserved':True},ensure_ascii=False))
